ararat_coherence.region_rule: valley floor = SRTM/Copernicus DEM < 900 m minus Yerevan and fish-farm boxes; foothills/bedrock = DEM 1200-2200 m; Yerevan = box 44.47-44.56E 40.15-40.21N; fish farms = box 44.53-44.68E 39.86-39.95N

sm_ararat.rain_note: Rain before the 31 Aug pass (docs/eda/validation-2026.md, SYNOP gauges, 48 h): Sevan 29.1 mm, Hrazdan 29.9 mm, Armavir (western valley) 0.4 mm; all other passes <= 1 mm. The Zvartnots METAR precipitation field is missing (M) for the whole period, so it is not used.
